headline_seed: US Navy chief leaving post 'effective immediately', Pentagon says
description_seed: US Navy Secretary John Phelan is the latest high-ranking military leader to leave the administration in recent months.

what: US Navy chief leaving post 'effective immediately', Pentagon says

clean_source_blocks.text: US Navy Secretary John Phelan is the latest high-ranking military leader to leave the administration in recent months.

Phelan is the latest high-ranking military leader to leave the administration in recent months. His departure comes amid the US-Israel war with Iran and the continued US blockade of the Strait of Hormuz.

“Secretary of the Navy John C. Phelan is departing the administration, effective immediately,” Sean Parnell, the chief Pentagon spokesman, said in a post on X. “On behalf of the Secretary of War and Deputy Secretary of War, we are grateful to Secretary Phelan for his service to the Department and the United States Navy. We wish him well in his future endeavors.”
US Navy Secretary John Phelan is leaving the Trump administration, the Pentagon announced on Wednesday.
